sourceAccess.note: 本轮两次抓取成功。'Blühdauer eines Exemplars etwa drei bis fünf Wochen';'eine einzelne Blüte ist aber bereits nach ein bis zwei Tagen verblüht';'produziert in 24 Stunden Nektar mit einem Gesamtzuckergehalt von 0,4 bis 2,1 mg';Aussaat Winterraps 'zweite Augusthälfte ... erste Septemberwoche'。重要:定向复查确认词条全篇无蜜腺(Nektarien)位置记载(NECTARY-LOCATION-ABSENT)。
抓取成功。'The flowers are white or pinkish, becoming brown and deflexed as the corolla fades.'(指白车轴草)
抓取成功。'the flowers appear at the same time as the leaves'。页面不给具体花期月份。

T&F 正文未抓;摘要经 Crossref API 获取成功。'Apis mellifera ... are normally placed within fields';'B. terrestris were considered a more efficient pollinator than A. mellifera moving faster between florets but were less effective due to low abundances';研究对象为新西兰白车轴草种子田。
抓取成功。'Flower Bloom Time: Summer','It blooms in the summer';Pollinator Garden / Attracts Pollinators 标签。只有'夏季'粒度,无具体月份。

PDF 本轮重新抓取并本地解析。'Most common cultivars of northern highbush can be well pollinated by their own pollen ... Others benefit greatly from cross-pollination';'Pollination increases fruit set, berry size, and allows for earlier ripening';'Carpenter bees often cut a slit in the side of blueberry flowers ... allowing honey bees to do the same in later visits. Nectar robbing bees still transfer some pollen ... can contribute to rather than take away from total pollination; however, when nectar robbing by honey bees begins to approach half of all honey bee visits, blueberry seed and fruit set are reduced.'

抓取成功。'Der Nektar hat zur Zeit der Hauptproduktion zwischen 10 und 14 Uhr auch den höchsten Zuckergehalt von 35 %'(泌蜜主产时段即10–14时,支持'中午前后最旺');'Die Blütezeit reicht von Ende Juni/Juli bis September'。词条无'对蜂是良好蜜源'的一般性表述。
本轮复查:向日葵单花蜜产地明确列 'France, Italy and Spain';薰衣草蜜 'Produced mainly in France, Italy and Spain'。
本轮复查:论文称美国90%杂交向日葵种子产自加州北部中央谷地;全篇不含大平原/中西部为主产区的表述。
本轮复查切叶蜂段落全文:'is increasingly used to circumvent these problems ... is a very efficient pollinator of alfalfa flowers'。无'每次/大多访花弹开'的频次表述。
本轮定向复查:NO-RATE-STATEMENT——无切叶蜂/碱蜂逐次弹花率;最接近表述为 'Both alkali bees and leafcutter bees are far more efficient, on a bee for bee basis, than honey bees in pollinating alfalfa.'

本轮经 Pensoft PDF 获取全文并本地解析。Tables 1–2 明确列 'Bombus terrestris/lucorum complex';两个样地熊蜂访花均占优、蜜蜂次之;'According to lavender essential oil producers, the greatest quantity of oil is obtained near the end of the inflorescence anthesis and the oil quantity correlates with the pollination as unpollinated flowers drop down (... personal communication)'——确系生产者经验而非对照研究;隔离结实0%(N=683) vs 对照85.9%;观察于2020年6–7月(植物园)与7月(种植园)。
Crossref 摘要本轮复查:研究材料明确为 'Lavandula × intermedia Grosso';熊蜂92% vs 蜜蜂8%。
本轮复查:正文含 1.1–1.4 秒 vs 3.5 秒;图片说明 'Honey bee on lavender Grosso'(正文未点名品种,品种名以 Balfour 摘要为准)。
